title: SEBI to release AI guidelines for capital markets, enhancing accountability and human oversight
source_used: ET CIO (Economic Times), read in full
key_facts: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) will shortly issue guidelines for the responsible use of AI and machine learning in capital markets.
SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said so on Saturday at the second Capital Market Confluence 2026, organised by the Bombay Stock Exchange Brokers' Forum.
The AI framework will follow a tiered approach with clear accountability, data controls, kill switches and human oversight.
It will align with the International Organization of Securities Commissions' supervisory toolkit for AI.
Pandey also expects guidelines on the settlement price of derivatives on expiry days in about a week.
No date for the AI guidelines is given beyond 'shortly'.
quote_evidence: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) will shortly issue guidelines for the responsible use of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning in capital markets, while it expects to release guidelines on the settlement price of derivatives on expiry days in about a week, Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said on Saturday.
Pandey said the AI framework would follow a tiered approach with clear accountability, data controls, kill switches and human oversight.
It will also align with the International Organization of Securities Commissions' supervisory toolkit for AI to support an agile governance framework.
why_it_matters_hint: India's market regulator signals human-oversight rules for AI in securities markets; details unpublished.
